prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Production BACKGROUND PANORAMA for a Gothic 2D side-scrolling cave game, high quality late SNES / GBA painted pixel art at 2x resolution. Wide landscape composition, approximately 2:1. A spectacular underground cavern made of crimson carnelian and dark ruby minerals: enormous pointed red flowstone curtains descend from high overhead, overlapping layered stalactite ridges, deep burgundy-black openings between formations, distant plum-red stone silhouettes. Large clearly readable sculpted forms, dramatic depth, glowing coral-red light catching a few sharp mineral edges, softly lit deep red mist below. Foreground playable gold platforms and characters will be added separately: do NOT draw a floor, platforms, stairs, people, creatures, skulls, faces, castles, buildings, lava, fire or UI. No sky or horizon. Keep the brightest ruby ridges along side columns and the middle-upper band, with darker wine-red and nearly black air through the center/lower portion so small game sprites remain readable. Continuous naturally varied cavern across the width; left and right edges should blend when repeated. Rich controlled crimson palette, subtle luminous seams, crisp deliberate painted pixel clusters and broad shaded facets, avoid photographic microtexture and noisy tiny repetition. No text, labels, borders or watermark. Fully opaque image.
